en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European river valley town taken from a high vantage point. A river runs through the center with several bridges, flanked by dense mid‑rise buildings and tree‑lined embankments. Steep, wooded hills rise on both sides, with terraced slopes on the right. A church with a tall steeple stands on the left hillside near a curved road and rail line. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.
